title: eriophyllum nubigenum var. congdonii
intro: Eriophyllum nubigenum var. congdonii, commonly known as Congdon's woolly sunflower, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is a shrubby perennial herb with a woody base, known for its medicinal properties and traditional uses. The health benefits of Congdon's woolly sunflower include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating wounds, skin irritations, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting tissue repair.
